label: Nature
description: What the unit is made of, which decides how EMP, psionic, toxic and electric attacks affect it.

terms.label: Organic
terms.description: Flesh: soldiers and animals. Unaffected by EMP; vulnerable to psionic and toxic attacks.

terms.label: Crewed machine
terms.description: A vehicle or mech with people inside: hit by EMP, sealed against most toxic attacks.

terms.label: Uncrewed machine
terms.description: A drone or robot: immune to psionic and toxic attacks, extra-vulnerable to electric and EMP.
